Name: M1
HubUpgrade: The pod unfolds its solar wing; work lights come on around it.
StoryHook: BT_P1_04 Ishani log 1. Echo tutorial step 4 (first machine).
Description: Machines, belts, power: the first factory.

Name: M2
HubUpgrade: A burner stack and storage lockers bolt onto the pod.
StoryHook: BT_P1_05 Ishani log 2. Echo tutorial step 7: the tower site and its list.
Description: Everything the Tower Base needs: riveted plate, reefcrete, cable.

Name: M3
HubUpgrade: A radio aerial and the drawing wall (Neela's drawings) appear on the pod.
StoryHook: BT_P2_03 first sighting (if not already fired by entering the Kelp Shallows).
Description: Glass, kelp, floating platforms and belts between islands; the Tide Lab.

Name: M4
HubUpgrade: A Glimmer-light lantern hangs from the aerial.
StoryHook: BT_P2_07 Ishani log. The Translator can now be built (BT_P2_04 on first build).
Description: Talk to the Glimmers, trade with them, and build the dish's frames and lenses.

Name: M5
HubUpgrade: A skiff dock and slipway are built beside the pod.
StoryHook: BT_P3_02 the sea darkens (if Ocean Health hasn't fired it first). Echo: the Tar Shelves are 900 m west.
Description: Steel, fluids, the skiff and the first big generator.

Name: M6
HubUpgrade: The pod gets a second deck and a taller antenna.
StoryHook: BT_P3_03 the withheld packet, then BT_P3_04 the Great Storm 30 s later.
Description: Tar, circuits and sealed cable: the Antenna Mast.

Name: M7
HubUpgrade: A crystal lightning rod crowns the pod.
StoryHook: BT_P4_02 the power choice: keep the burners, or rebuild clean (Glimmer blueprint, trust 20).
Description: Oscillators, stators and motors for the big machines.

Name: M8
HubUpgrade: A crane arm unfolds over the pod.
StoryHook: BT_P4_03 the ill child, then BT_P4_04 the medkit choice.
Description: Three-input machines: heavy frames and control modules for the Power Ring.

Name: M9
HubUpgrade: Echo's relay console lights up inside the pod.
StoryHook: BT_P5_03 confession 1, BT_P5_04 FB5 "The Garage", then the cold stretch.
Description: Calibrate the relay with deep lenses. It finds what Echo has been hiding.

Name: M10
HubUpgrade: The pod's beacon turns blue. It is ready to fly (the return capsule of Ending A).
StoryHook: BT_P5_06 the thaw: Echo's voice returns.
Description: The tower can take the Signal Core.
